Trial & billing terms

Clear terms, before you start

Card, Google Pay, Apple Pay or PayPal

You get a 30-day free trial, which you can cancel at any time within the 30 days. Before the trial starts, a pre-authorisation hold of $15 is placed on your payment method. [Confirm when the hold is released]

After the trial

To cancel, give at least 30 days’ notice. Your service ends on your renewal date. [Confirm how notice is given, and what happens if notice falls inside 30 days of renewal]

Paying in USDT or USDC

There is no standard free trial. Instead, you get a 30-day trial limited to one exchange or wallet connection. [Confirm which networks/chains are accepted for payment]

Changing plan

Upgrade at any time: your new plan and contract start immediately. If you upgrade part way through an annual plan, a new 12-month plan starts at the higher price, and the unused part of your current plan is credited against it. Monthly plans work the same way: the new plan starts immediately at the higher fee, the unused part of your current month is credited against your first new monthly fee, and every month after that is charged on the new plan. Downgrades take effect at your next renewal date.

Set-up takes minutes. As soon as your payment is confirmed, you can start connecting providers and inviting your team.

Prices exclude any applicable taxes [confirm VAT/sales-tax treatment]. Full terms: Terms of service. Questions: Billing FAQ.
